input: Find outdoor adventure, nature, farm, horseback riding and sports summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Marion, Old Fort, Little Switzerland, Burnsville, Spruce Pine, Bakersville and Morganton, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Marion Old Fort NC summer camp 2026 kids sports nature

candidates.name: Camp Grier
candidates.note: Day and overnight camps with hiking, paddling, climbing, equestrian activities and teen wilderness programs.

candidates.name: Camp Timberlake
candidates.note: Christian overnight adventure camp for boys in grades 1–11; summer 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Big League Camp
candidates.note: Five-day baseball and softball camps with outdoor challenges for ages 12–19; under-13 campers attend by day only.

candidates.name: Camp Celo
candidates.note: Farm-based summer camp with animal care, gardening, hiking, camping, swimming and tubing; 2027 dates announced.

candidates.name: Camp Spring Creek
candidates.note: Residential camp for children with dyslexia combining tutoring with swimming, hiking, climbing and other outdoor activities.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Mitchell County Center
candidates.note: 2026 4-H Summer Fun included shooting sports, nature crafts and horticulture camps, plus cooking and STEM; ages 5–18 vary by session.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Burke County Center
candidates.note: 2025 supervised Summer Fun day programs included Farm & Fish Day, Mountain Adventure and a five-day water-themed camp.

candidates.name: City of Morganton Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 camps included science/nature and sports/adventure themes for ages 8–12, a younger-child mini-camp and a disability-inclusive camp.

candidates.name: Foothills Little Explorers
candidates.note: Drop-off nature camps at Oak Hill Community Park & Forest; summer 2027 dates pending.

candidates.name: Bigfoot Climbing Gym
candidates.note: 2026 Monday–Thursday climbing camps for ages 6–11, with games, climbing skills and art projects.

candidates.name: Carolina Outdoor Recreation & Education (CORE)
candidates.note: Youth outdoor education program includes six-day local summer expeditions for its middle age groups.

candidates.name: YMCA of Catawba Valley
candidates.note: Summer day camps at multiple Morganton elementary schools, with recreation, sports and adventure activities.

candidates.name: Challenger Sports
candidates.note: 2026 International Soccer Camp listing for ages 6–12 in Morganton.
